title: When Does Reasoning Help Entity Disambiguation? Small LLMs In-Domain and Under Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.30334v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance. Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains. However, it is unclear whether this capability survives, or remains competitive, with smaller LLMs, where entity disambiguation has typically relied on reranking rather than reasoning. We ask when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale. We compare pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components within a classical coarse-to-fine entity disambiguation pipeline, across the classical, few-shot and true zero-shot settings. translated_title: 推理何时有助于实体消歧？领域内及分布偏移下的小型大语言模型
translated_abstract: 实体消歧（将文本中的歧义提及映射到知识库中的实体）是知识图谱构建、问答和信息抽取等任务的基础步骤。近期工作已将大语言模型应用于这一问题，并取得了最先进的性能。值得注意的是，已有研究表明推理型大语言模型能够以真正的零样本方式执行实体消歧，并可跨知识库和领域泛化。然而，尚不清楚这种能力在较小的大语言模型上是否依然成立或保持竞争力，因为在小型模型上，实体消歧通常依赖重排序而非推理。我们探讨在小规模场景下，推理何时值得其付出的代价。我们在经典的由粗到细实体消歧流程中，比较了逐点式、列表式和基于推理的候选选择组件，涵盖经典、少样本和真正零样本三种设置。该推理范式通过蒸馏进行训练，（摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文在经典由粗到细实体消歧流程中，系统比较了小型大语言模型下逐点式、列表式与基于推理的候选选择方法在领域内和分布偏移场景下的表现，探究了小规模场景下推理何时值得其代价。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares pointwise, listwise, and reasoning-based candidate-selection components for entity disambiguation using small LLMs in-domain and under distribution shift, investigating when reasoning is worth its cost at small scale.
